title: Normadan biroz oshish — yig'im bojdan qimmat
caption: 💸 Tovar normadan 5 $ oshdi — 195 665 so'm to'laysiz Misol: kuryer orqali kiyim-kechak — tovarlar 205 $, 2 kg, yo'l harajati 19 $. Tovar narxi 200 $ dan oshgani uchun BKO rasmiylashtiriladi va bojxona qiymatiga yo'l harajati ham qo'shiladi: 1️⃣ Bojxona qiymati: 205 + 19 = 224 $ 2️⃣ Normadan ortig'i: 224 − 200 = 24 $ 3️⃣ Boj 30 %: 24 × 30 % = 7,20 $ ≈ 85 665 so'm 4️⃣ 1 ta BKO uchun yig'im: BHM ning 25 % = 110 000 so'm 💰 Jami: 195 665 so'm ✂️ Yechim: 15 $ lik bitta mayda tovarni keyingi oyga qoldiring — tovarlar 190 $ bo'ladi: norma ichida, yo'l hisobga olinmaydi, boj ham, yig'im ham yo'q. 📅 2027-yil 1-iyundan: boj yig'imdan kam bo'lsa, yig'im undirilmaydi (PF-174, 3-band «g»). 📄 Asos: VM 244-son; PQ-4508, 3-band; VM 55-son, 31.01.2025; PF-174 — lex.uz 📲 Normangizni ilovada hisoblang ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #boj
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#boj".
2) Center: a cardboard parcel on a balance scale, tipping slightly past a thin indigo line marked 200 $; next to it a small coin and a much bigger stack of coins with a receipt slip, showing the fee outweighs the duty. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of amber (#F59E0B); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Normadan biroz oshdingizmi?"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Yig'im bojdan qimmat bo'lishi mumkin"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Muallif qoidasi (11.10.2026): tovar 200 $ gacha — boj yo'q, yo'l qo'shilmaydi; oshsa — BKO, bojxona qiymati = tovar + yo'l. Minimal 3 $/kg qo'llanmadi. Hisob: (205.0 + 19.0 − 200) × 30 % = 7.2 $ × 11897.9 = 85665 so'm; + BKO 110000. BKO stavkasi va BHM lex.uz da qayta tekshirilmagan.
